name: GeneHop
description: GeneHop is a novel dataset introduced to evaluate multi-hop question answering capabilities of large language models using NCBI Web APIs in the biomedical domain.
reputation: A newer biomedical multi-hop QA benchmark that is useful for probing API-grounded reasoning, but it is not yet as widely adopted as older biomedical QA datasets.
notes: Introduced alongside GeneGPT method; focuses on multi-hop genomics questions using API calls.
